mines.mine_notes: 70% JV with Sumitomo Metal Mining (SMM); IAMGOLD repurchased 9.7% interest Nov 2024 returning to 70%. Production 279,900 oz attributable (399,800 oz at 100%). First full year of operations; achieved nameplate 36,000 tpd. Grade is mill feed head grade (full year); recovery 93%. Sustaining capex $103.8M attributable ($148.0M at 100%). Gosselin deposit is a resource-stage expansion within the Cote complex.
mines.processing: Primary/secondary crushing, HPGR, ball milling, gravity concentration, cyanide leach, CIP (36,000 tpd)

mines.mine_notes: Westwood Complex: Westwood underground mine + Grand Duc open pit. 2025 production 113,900 oz (below guidance 125-140 koz due to lower-grade stopes sequenced earlier and higher dilution). Grade is total head grade (underground 7.59 g/t, open pit 1.22 g/t); recovery 92%.
mines.processing: Conventional cyanidation at the Doyon process plant (ore trucked 2.5 km)

mines.mine_notes: Ownership 90% H1 2025, reduced to 85% effective June 20, 2025 (Burkina Faso government increased its stake to 15% under amended mining code). Production 372,100 oz attributable (427,200 oz at 100%). Grade is mill head grade; recovery 90%. Cash costs include royalties (royalty rate raised Apr 2025: minimum 8% at gold >$3,000/oz). Sustaining capex $106.9M (100% basis). Security situation in Burkina Faso a noted risk/cost driver.
mines.processing: SAG/ball grinding, gravity circuit, pre-leach, CIL/CIP

mines.mine_notes: Key development project in Quebec (Nelligan, Monster Lake, Philibert (75%), Chevrier deposits; Philibert/Chevrier acquired via Northern Superior transaction Dec 2025). Resources only, no reserves. Northern Superior acquisition also added regional exploration ground.

notes: TSX listing symbol is IMG per the AIF (NYSE: IAG). Production and reserves reported on attributable basis; 100%-basis figures noted per mine. Total attributable gold production 765,900 oz (940,900 oz at 100%). Essakane interest changed from 90% to 85% mid-year 2025. Diakha-Siribaya (Mali, 90%) held for sale - excluded. Mineral reserves estimated at $2,000/oz gold (Westwood, Essakane) and $1,700/oz (Cote); resources at $2,500/oz (Cote $2,100/oz). All amounts in USD. Cost of sales, cash costs and AISC on attributable ounce-sold basis.
